module_summary: AXI-stream FIFO with width adaptation: an optional upsizing adapter before or downsizing adapter after a single axis_fifo instance, otherwise straight bypass wiring.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream data routed to pre-FIFO path or upsizing adapter.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid forwarded to FIFO write side.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready taken from FIFO write-side ready (or adapter).

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream data from FIFO read side or downsizing adapter.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from FIFO read side.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready driving FIFO read-side ready.

anchors.name: pre_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Width-adapted data entering the FIFO instance.

anchors.name: post_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Data leaving the FIFO before optional downsizing adapter.

anchors.name: pre_fifo_axis_tready
anchors.why: FIFO write ready back to input side.

anchors.name: post_fifo_axis_tready
anchors.why: Ready into FIFO read port from output side.

anchors.name: pause_req
anchors.why: Pause request passed to FIFO to halt output.

anchors.name: status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy depth reported from FIFO instance.

groups.name: input_width_adapter
groups.description: Optional upsizing adapter or bypass feeding the FIFO write side.

groups.name: fifo
groups.description: axis_fifo instance with pause handshake and depth/frame status.

groups.name: output_width_adapter
groups.description: Optional downsizing adapter or bypass driving the output stream.
